entities.summary: Sri Mulyani Indrawati (b. 1962-08-26, Bandar Lampung) was a monarch or head of state of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Bandar Lampung and Indonesia. Known in the fields of indonesia, educators & academics, asia.
